California.reason: California Business and Professions Code Section 16600 voids post-employment non-competes regardless of the contract's stated governing law.

India.reason: Section 27 of the Indian Contract Act voids post-employment non-competes, overriding foreign governing law clauses if executed locally.

Washington.reason: Washington State law restricts non-competes for employees earning less than the mandated threshold, and strictly limits duration.
